    <script>
        const NODE_SELECTOR = ".target.parbase,#ctcadobetarget";
        const createIntersectionObserver = () => {
            return new IntersectionObserver(
                (entries, observer) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        const target = entry.target;
                        if (entry.intersectionRatio >= 1) {
                            const nonEmptyPromos = Array.from(target.querySelectorAll('a[data-analytics-type="promoCta"], button[data-analytics-type="promoCta"]')).filter(
                                item =>
                                    item.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0 &&
                                    (item.classList.contains('js-promo-cta-name') ||
                                        item.querySelectorAll('.js-promo-cta-name').length > 0),
                            );
                            // passing CTA value as undefined when promo CTA is empty
                            let ctaText = undefined;
                            if (nonEmptyPromos.length > 1) {
                                ctaText = 'multi-select';
                            } else if (nonEmptyPromos.length === 1) {
                                const nonEmptyPromo = nonEmptyPromos[0];
                                if (nonEmptyPromo.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
                                    if (nonEmptyPromo.children.length > 0) {
                                        // if feature list have wrapper component anchor tag and extract the link with 'js-promo-cta-name'
                                        ctaText = nonEmptyPromo.querySelector('js-promo-cta-name')?.textContent.trim();
                                    } else {
                                        ctaText = nonEmptyPromo.text.trim();
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    ctaText = nonEmptyPromos.textContent.trim();
                                }
                            }
                            const promoAnalyticsData = target.dataset['analytics'] ? JSON.parse(target.dataset['analytics'].replace(/'/g, '"')) : {};
                            analyticsLayer.push({
                                event: 'promoView',
                                promotion: {
                                    cta: ctaText,
                                    ...promoAnalyticsData
                                }
                            });
                            observer.disconnect();
                        }
                    });
                },
                {
                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: '0px',
                    threshold: 1.0,
                },
            );
        }

        const attachAnalyticsHandler = (target) => {
            target.querySelectorAll('div[data-analytics-type="promo"], li[data-analytics-type="promo"]').forEach((targetedComponent) => {
                if (!targetedComponent.dataset['analyticsInit']) {
                    const promoAnalyticsData = targetedComponent.dataset['analytics'] ? JSON.parse(targetedComponent.dataset['analytics'].replace(/'/g, '"')) : {};
                    createIntersectionObserver().observe(targetedComponent);
                    targetedComponent.querySelectorAll('a[data-analytics-type="promoCta"], button[data-analytics-type="promoCta"]').forEach((targetedCta) => {
                        if (targetedCta.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                            if (targetedCta.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
                                targetedCta.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                                    const element = e.target;
                                    let hrefValue = element.href;
                                    let targetValue = element.target;
                                    if (!hrefValue) {
                                        const anchorClosest = element.closest('a');
                                        hrefValue = anchorClosest.href;
                                        targetValue = anchorClosest.target;
                                    }
                                    const promoCtaLink = element.closest('div[data-analytics-type="promo"], li[data-analytics-type="promo"]').querySelectorAll('.js-promo-cta-name');
                                    let ctaText = '';
                                    if (promoCtaLink.length > 0 && element.getAttribute('data-analytics-type') !== 'promoCta') {
                                        ctaText = promoCtaLink[0]?.textContent?.trim() || promoCtaLink[0]?.children[0]?.getAttribute('alt') || undefined;
                                    } else {
                                        ctaText = element?.text?.trim() || undefined;
                                    }
                                    analyticsLayer.push({
                                        event: 'promoClick',
                                        promotion: {
                                            cta: ctaText,
                                            ...promoAnalyticsData
                                        }
                                    });
                                });
                            } else {
                                targetedCta.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                                    const element = e.target;
                                    analyticsLayer.push({
                                        event: 'promoClick',
                                        promotion: {
                                            cta: element?.textContent?.trim() || undefined,
                                            ...promoAnalyticsData
                                        }
                                    });
                                })
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
                targetedComponent.dataset['analyticsInit'] = true
            });
        }

        window.addEventListener('load', function () {
            var elements = document.querySelectorAll(NODE_SELECTOR);
            elements.forEach(attachAnalyticsHandler);
        });

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
            var mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
                mutations.forEach(function (mutation) {
                    var target = mutation.target; // DOM NodeList
                    if (mutation.addedNodes) {
                        attachAnalyticsHandler(target);
                    }
                });
            });
            var elements = document.querySelectorAll(NODE_SELECTOR);
            elements.forEach((ele) => {
                mutationObserver.observe(ele, {
                    attributes: false,
                    childList: true,
                    characterData: false,
                    subtree: true
                });
            });
        });
    </script>

                            let ctaText = undefined;
                            if (nonEmptyPromos.length > 1) {
                                ctaText = 'multi-select';
                            } else if (nonEmptyPromos.length === 1) {
                                const nonEmptyPromo = nonEmptyPromos[0];
                                if (nonEmptyPromo.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
                                    if (nonEmptyPromo.children.length > 0) {
                                        // if feature list have wrapper component anchor tag and extract the link with 'js-promo-cta-name'
                                        ctaText = nonEmptyPromo.querySelector('js-promo-cta-name')?.textContent.trim();
                                    } else {
                                        ctaText = nonEmptyPromo.text.trim();
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    ctaText = nonEmptyPromos.textContent.trim();
                                }
                            }
                            const promoAnalyticsData = target.dataset['analytics'] ? JSON.parse(target.dataset['analytics'].replace(/'/g, '"')) : {};
                            analyticsLayer.push({
                                event: 'promoView',
                                promotion: {
                                    cta: ctaText,
                                    ...promoAnalyticsData

                },

                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: '0px',
                    threshold: 1.0,

        }

        const attachAnalyticsHandler = (target) => {
            target.querySelectorAll('div[data-analytics-type="promo"], li[data-analytics-type="promo"]').forEach((targetedComponent) => {
                if (!targetedComponent.dataset['analyticsInit']) {
                    const promoAnalyticsData = targetedComponent.dataset['analytics'] ? JSON.parse(targetedComponent.dataset['analytics'].replace(/'/g, '"')) : {};
                    createIntersectionObserver().observe(targetedComponent);
                    targetedComponent.querySelectorAll('a[data-analytics-type="promoCta"], button[data-analytics-type="promoCta"]').forEach((targetedCta) => {
                        if (targetedCta.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                            if (targetedCta.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
                                targetedCta.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                                    const element = e.target;
                                    let hrefValue = element.href;
                                    let targetValue = element.target;
                                    if (!hrefValue) {
                                        const anchorClosest = element.closest('a');
                                        hrefValue = anchorClosest.href;
                                        targetValue = anchorClosest.target;
                                    }
                                    const promoCtaLink = element.closest('div[data-analytics-type="promo"], li[data-analytics-type="promo"]').querySelectorAll('.js-promo-cta-name');
                                    let ctaText = '';
                                    if (promoCtaLink.length > 0 && element.getAttribute('data-analytics-type') !== 'promoCta') {
                                        ctaText = promoCtaLink[0]?.textContent?.trim() || promoCtaLink[0]?.children[0]?.getAttribute('alt') || undefined;
                                    } else {
                                        ctaText = element?.text?.trim() || undefined;

                                            cta: ctaText,
                                            ...promoAnalyticsData

                                            cta: element?.textContent?.trim() || undefined,

                                        }
                                    });
                                })

                        }
                    });
                }

    <script>
        const NODE_SELECTOR = ".target.parbase,#ctcadobetarget";
        const createIntersectionObserver = () => {
            return new IntersectionObserver(
                (entries, observer) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        const target = entry.target;
                        if (entry.intersectionRatio >= 1) {
                            const nonEmptyPromos = Array.from(target.querySelectorAll('a[data-analytics-type="promoCta"], button[data-analytics-type="promoCta"]')).filter(
                                item =>
                                    item.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0 &&
                                    (item.classList.contains('js-promo-cta-name') ||
                                        item.querySelectorAll('.js-promo-cta-name').length > 0),
                            );
                            // passing CTA value as undefined when promo CTA is empty
                            let ctaText = undefined;
                            if (nonEmptyPromos.length > 1) {
                                ctaText = 'multi-select';
                            } else if (nonEmptyPromos.length === 1) {
                                const nonEmptyPromo = nonEmptyPromos[0];
                                if (nonEmptyPromo.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
                                    if (nonEmptyPromo.children.length > 0) {
                                        // if feature list have wrapper component anchor tag and extract the link with 'js-promo-cta-name'
                                        ctaText = nonEmptyPromo.querySelector('js-promo-cta-name')?.textContent.trim();
                                    } else {
                                        ctaText = nonEmptyPromo.text.trim();
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    ctaText = nonEmptyPromos.textContent.trim();
                                }
                            }
                            const promoAnalyticsData = target.dataset['analytics'] ? JSON.parse(target.dataset['analytics'].replace(/'/g, '"')) : {};
                            analyticsLayer.push({
                                event: 'promoView',
                                promotion: {
                                    cta: ctaText,
                                    ...promoAnalyticsData
                                }
                            });
                            observer.disconnect();
                        }
                    });
                },
                {
                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: '0px',
                    threshold: 1.0,
                },
            );
        }

        const attachAnalyticsHandler = (target) => {

<p>These Linked Loyalty Benefit earn rates are inclusive of any Triangle credit card earn rates that are already applied in accordance with the <a href="https://triangle.canadiantire.ca/en/support/legal-and-privacy/program-rules.html">Triangle Rewards Program Terms and Conditions</a>. Refer to the <a href="https://triangle.canadiantire.ca/en/partners.html">Triangle Rewards' Partner Page</a> for additional information.</p>
<p>CT Money earned with the Linked Loyalty Benefit Earn Rate and Scan & Pay Bonus will be rounded up or down to the nearest cent and CT Money earned with the Triangle Credit Card Earn Rate will be rounded down to the nearest cent.</p>
<p> </p>
<p>CT Money earn rates are subject to change. See Section 14 for further information on changes.</p>
<p>CTC is solely responsible for the calculation, issuance, administration, redemption, expiry and forfeiture of CT Money, in accordance with the <a href="https://triangle.canadiantire.ca/en/support/legal-and-privacy/program-rules.html">Triangle Rewards Program Terms and Conditions</a>.</p>
<p>Terms and conditions apply to earning and redeeming CT Money. Your participation in the Triangle Rewards Program is governed by the Triangle Rewards Program Terms and Conditions. Refer to the Triangle Rewards Program Terms and Conditions on <a href="https://triangle.canadiantire.ca/en/partners.html">Triangle Rewards' Partner Page</a> for additional information.</p>
<p>CT Money is exclusive of any bonus or promotional offers.</p>
<p><b>11. No Paper CT Money</b>: Paper CT Money will not be issued.</p>
<p><b> </b></p>
<p><b>12. Use of CT Money:</b> CT Money cannot be redeemed for any purchases at Tim Hortons or used as a credit against an outstanding balance on a Tim Hortons credit card account.</p>
<p><b>13. Future Offers:</b> CTC and Tim Hortons may make available additional or different offers as part of the Linked Loyalty Benefit from time to time. Such offers may be subject to additional terms and conditions which will be made available in connection with any such offer.</p>
<p><b> </b></p>
<p><b>14. Changes to Linked Loyalty Benefit:</b> Subject to applicable laws and regulations, the Linked Loyalty Benefit may be changed, cancelled or withdrawn, including but not limited to, changes to (i) the eligibility criteria to participate in the Linked Loyalty Benefit; (ii) the benefits associated with linking, including the rate at which CT Money is earned; (iii) the types of cards/accounts eligible for the Linked Loyalty Benefit; (iv) rules relating to the operation of the Linked Loyalty Benefit; (v) rules relating to the suspension or termination of your participation in the Linked Loyalty Benefit; (vi) rules relating to errors in the allocation of CT Money and the handling of complaints; and vii) the provisions related to the modification of all or any of these Terms. You may refuse these modifications and terminate your participation in the Linked Loyalty Benefit without cost, penalty or cancellation indemnity at any time.</p>
<p>In the event of a material error, omission, technical problem, computer virus or bugs, tampering, unauthorized intervention, fraud, technical failure or any other cause beyond our reasonable control that interferes with the proper conduct of any aspect of the Linked Loyalty Benefit as set out in these Terms, CTC and Tim Hortons reserve the right to withdraw or temporarily change or suspend all or part of the Linked Loyalty Benefit as they may determine in their sole discretion.   </p>
<p>Notwithstanding the above, you acknowledge and agree that, subject to applicable laws, we may not notify you: (i) every time we expand the Linked Loyalty Benefit to add new or modify Linked Loyalty Benefit features and offers; (ii) every time we expand our Linked Loyalty Benefit to add new cards/accounts; (iii) of changes to the Linked Loyalty Benefit  and/or the Terms such as those that are purely cosmetic or organizational (such as changes to punctuation, vocabulary, paragraph order, etc.), procedural, or for any other non-substantive changes; provided these changes do not negatively impact your rights, benefits or obligations under the Linked Loyalty Benefit and/or these Terms. <br />
<br />
Notification required pursuant to these Terms, including when changes made to the Linked Loyalty Benefit will be provided to you in accordance with the applicable law of your Province or Territory.</p>
<p>For Quebec residents, we will send you a written notice, drafted clearly and legibly, setting out exclusively the new or amended clause, the clause as it read formerly, the effective date of the change, and your rights to refuse the change and cancel the contract without cost, penalty or cancellation indemnity. This written notice will be sent to you between ninety (90) days and sixty (60) days prior to a change of an essential element of the Linked Loyalty Benefit or thirty (30) days prior to a change of a non-essential element of the Linked Loyalty Benefit. The notice may be sent to you by electronic transmission, when applicable. CTC may make changes to the Triangle Rewards Program in accordance with the <a href="https://triangle.canadiantire.ca/en/support/legal-and-privacy/program-rules.html">Triangle Rewards Program Terms and Conditions</a> and Tim Hortons may make changes to the Tims Rewards Program in accordance with the <a href="https://www.westjet.com/en-ca/rewards/terms-conditions">Tims Rewards Program Terms & Conditions - Tim Hortons.</a></p>
<p><b>15. Cancellation:</b> Subject to applicable laws and notice requirements, either CTC or Tim Hortons may unlink any Triangle Rewards Account and  Tims Rewards Account, including if you are or become ineligible for the Linked Loyalty Benefit, when either CTC or Tim Hortons suspect fraudulent activity, misuse of the Triangle Rewards Program, non-compliance with these Terms or for any other reason specified in the Triangle Rewards Terms and Conditions or for any other reasonable reason.<br />
<br />
<b>16. System errors:</b> CTC reserves the right to make any adjustments and correct any errors pertaining to your CT Money, in accordance with the Triangle Rewards Program Terms and Conditions. You may contact CTC for any questions related to CT Money issuance. See Section 24. </p>
<p><b>17. Immediate/Real-Time Linking of Rewards Accounts:</b> Once you click the “Link Accounts” button, your Triangle Rewards Account and Tims Rewards Account will be linked after receiving confirmation that linking is complete.   </p>
<p><b>18. Unlinking: </b>You can unlink your Triangle Rewards Account and Tims Rewards Account at any time; however, prior to unlinking, Linked Members must ensure any CT Money earned has been processed and credited to their Triangle Rewards Account. Unlinking your Triangle Rewards Account and Tims Rewards Accounts will not end your separate enrollment in the Triangle Rewards Program or the Tims Rewards Program. Upon unlinking, you will no longer be able to participate in the Linked Loyalty Benefit.</p>
<p><b>GENERAL</b></p>
<p><b> </b></p>
<p><b>19. Enrollment in Triangle Rewards</b>: In order to participate in the Linked Loyalty Benefit, you must be a registered member in the Triangle Rewards Program. Your Triangle Rewards Account must be registered before attempting to link it to your Tims Rewards Account, otherwise you will be asked to do so before completion of linking can occur.</p>
<p><b>20. Enrollment in Tims Rewards Program</b>: In order to participate in the Linked Loyalty Benefit, you must be a registered member in the Tims Rewards Program. Your Tims Rewards Account must be registered before attempting to link it to your Triangle Rewards Account, otherwise you will be asked to do so before completion of linking can occur.</p>
<p><b>21. Triangle Rewards and Tims Rewards are Independent:</b> CTC and Tim Hortons will continue to independently operate the Triangle Rewards Program and Tims Rewards Program, respectively.</p>
<p><b>22. CTC is not an Agent of Tim Hortons:</b> CTC does not act on behalf of Tim Hortons.  CTC is solely and exclusively responsible for (i) the services and benefits offered through the Triangle Rewards Program; (ii) the administration of such program, including how you can earn and redeem CT Money; and (iii) the Triangle Rewards Program Terms and Conditions.  Tim Hortons does not act on behalf of CTC.</p>
<p><b>23. Tim Hortons is not an Agent of CTC:</b> Tim Hortons does not act on behalf of CTC. Tim Hortons is solely and exclusively responsible for (i) the services and benefits offered through the Tims Rewards Program; (ii) the administration of such program, including how you can earn and redeem Tims Rewards Points; and (iii) the Tims Rewards Program Terms and Conditions. CTC does not act on behalf of Tim Hortons.</p>
<p><b>24. Contacting CTC:</b>  If you have any questions related to the Triangle Rewards Program, including about your CT Money balance or account you may contact Triangle Rewards customer service by calling 1-800-226-8743 or by mail at PO Box 2000 Station Main, Welland, Ontario L3B 5S3.</p>
<p><b>25. [LB1]</p>
<p><b>26. Governing Law</b>: These Terms are governed by the law of the Province or Territory in which you reside at the time you link your Triangle Rewards Account and Tims Rewards Account, and the applicable federal laws of Canada.</p>
<p><b>27. Account Status Changes:</b>  If you do not receive confirmation that linking is complete after twenty-four (24) hours, you should notify CTC at the contact details listed above. <p><b>PRIVACY AND HANDLING OF PERSONAL INFORMATION</b></p>
<p><b> </b></p>
<p><b>28. <p>CTC Privacy Charter: <a href="https://www.canadiantire.ca/en/customer-service/policies.html">www.canadiantire.ca/en/customer-service/policies.html</a><br />
Tim Hortons Privacy Policy:  <a href="https://www.timhortons.ca/privacy-policy">www.timhortons.ca/privacy-policy</a><br />
<br />
</p>
<p><b>29. Each party Handles personal information in accordance with its own privacy policy.</p>
<p><b>30. Marketing</b>: CTC and Tim Hortons may communicate with you about your use of, or to promote and provide information about the benefits, services, and rewards of the Linked Loyalty Benefit, Triangle Rewards, or Tims Rewards Program in accordance with their respective consent records and applicable anti-spam legislation. <p>To opt out, contact CTC or Tim Hortons (the organization whose activities you want to opt out from) using the information under “Your privacy rights and choices” below.</p>
<p><b>31. In those cases, your personal information may be subject to the laws of those jurisdictions. CTC and Tim Hortons will protect personal information in accordance with applicable privacy laws and each of their respective privacy policies. </p>
<p><b>32. Your privacy rights and choices</b>: You may obtain access to the information CTC or Tim Hortons holds about you at any time and review its content and accuracy, and request corrections as appropriate; however, access may be restricted as permitted or required by law.</p>
<p>To request access to such information, to ask questions about our privacy policies or to request that the information not be used for any purpose, including opt-out, you may do so now or at any time in the future by contacting CTC at 1-866-846-5841 or Tim Hortons at1-888-601-1616, or using the information provided in the <a href="http://www.canadiantire.ca/en/customer-service/policies.html">CTC Privacy Charter</a> or <a href="https://www.timhortons.ca/privacy-policy">Tim Hortons Privacy Policy</a>.</p>

        const gigyaReadinessTimeout = gigyaReadinessTimeoutValue || 180000
        const startTime = Date.now()
        const startTimeISOFormat = new Date().toISOString()

            new Promise(resolve => {
                window.onGigyaServiceReady = () => resolve({
                    isReady: window.gigya.isReady,
                    gigyaWaitingTime: Date.now() - startTime,
                })

                    })

        ])

    <script>
        const NODE_SELECTOR = ".target.parbase,#ctcadobetarget";
        const createIntersectionObserver = () => {
            return new IntersectionObserver(
                (entries, observer) => {
                    entries.forEach(entry => {
                        const target = entry.target;
                        if (entry.intersectionRatio >= 1) {
                            const nonEmptyPromos = Array.from(target.querySelectorAll('a[data-analytics-type="promoCta"], button[data-analytics-type="promoCta"]')).filter(
                                item =>
                                    item.getBoundingClientRect().height > 0 &&
                                    (item.classList.contains('js-promo-cta-name') ||
                                        item.querySelectorAll('.js-promo-cta-name').length > 0),
                            );
                            // passing CTA value as undefined when promo CTA is empty
                            let ctaText = undefined;
                            if (nonEmptyPromos.length > 1) {
                                ctaText = 'multi-select';
                            } else if (nonEmptyPromos.length === 1) {
                                const nonEmptyPromo = nonEmptyPromos[0];
                                if (nonEmptyPromo.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
                                    if (nonEmptyPromo.children.length > 0) {
                                        // if feature list have wrapper component anchor tag and extract the link with 'js-promo-cta-name'
                                        ctaText = nonEmptyPromo.querySelector('js-promo-cta-name')?.textContent.trim();
                                    } else {
                                        ctaText = nonEmptyPromo.text.trim();
                                    }
                                } else {
                                    ctaText = nonEmptyPromos.textContent.trim();
                                }
                            }
                            const promoAnalyticsData = target.dataset['analytics'] ? JSON.parse(target.dataset['analytics'].replace(/'/g, '"')) : {};
                            analyticsLayer.push({
                                event: 'promoView',
                                promotion: {
                                    cta: ctaText,
                                    ...promoAnalyticsData
                                }
                            });
                            observer.disconnect();
                        }
                    });
                },
                {
                    root: null,
                    rootMargin: '0px',
                    threshold: 1.0,
                },
            );
        }

        const attachAnalyticsHandler = (target) => {
            target.querySelectorAll('div[data-analytics-type="promo"], li[data-analytics-type="promo"]').forEach((targetedComponent) => {
                if (!targetedComponent.dataset['analyticsInit']) {
                    const promoAnalyticsData = targetedComponent.dataset['analytics'] ? JSON.parse(targetedComponent.dataset['analytics'].replace(/'/g, '"')) : {};
                    createIntersectionObserver().observe(targetedComponent);
                    targetedComponent.querySelectorAll('a[data-analytics-type="promoCta"], button[data-analytics-type="promoCta"]').forEach((targetedCta) => {
                        if (targetedCta.nodeType === Node.ELEMENT_NODE) {
                            if (targetedCta.nodeName.toLowerCase() === 'a') {
                                targetedCta.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                                    const element = e.target;
                                    let hrefValue = element.href;
                                    let targetValue = element.target;
                                    if (!hrefValue) {
                                        const anchorClosest = element.closest('a');
                                        hrefValue = anchorClosest.href;
                                        targetValue = anchorClosest.target;
                                    }
                                    const promoCtaLink = element.closest('div[data-analytics-type="promo"], li[data-analytics-type="promo"]').querySelectorAll('.js-promo-cta-name');
                                    let ctaText = '';
                                    if (promoCtaLink.length > 0 && element.getAttribute('data-analytics-type') !== 'promoCta') {
                                        ctaText = promoCtaLink[0]?.textContent?.trim() || promoCtaLink[0]?.children[0]?.getAttribute('alt') || undefined;
                                    } else {
                                        ctaText = element?.text?.trim() || undefined;
                                    }
                                    analyticsLayer.push({
                                        event: 'promoClick',
                                        promotion: {
                                            cta: ctaText,
                                            ...promoAnalyticsData
                                        }
                                    });
                                });
                            } else {
                                targetedCta.addEventListener('click', (e) => {
                                    const element = e.target;
                                    analyticsLayer.push({
                                        event: 'promoClick',
                                        promotion: {
                                            cta: element?.textContent?.trim() || undefined,
                                            ...promoAnalyticsData
                                        }
                                    });
                                })
                            }
                        }
                    });
                }
                targetedComponent.dataset['analyticsInit'] = true
            });
        }

        window.addEventListener('load', function () {
            var elements = document.querySelectorAll(NODE_SELECTOR);
            elements.forEach(attachAnalyticsHandler);
        });

        document.addEventListener("DOMContentLoaded", function () {
            var mutationObserver = new MutationObserver(mutations => {
                mutations.forEach(function (mutation) {
                    var target = mutation.target; // DOM NodeList
                    if (mutation.addedNodes) {
                        attachAnalyticsHandler(target);
                    }
                });
            });
            var elements = document.querySelectorAll(NODE_SELECTOR);
            elements.forEach((ele) => {
                mutationObserver.observe(ele, {
                    attributes: false,
                    childList: true,
                    characterData: false,
                    subtree: true
                });
            });
        });
    </script>
